name: Healthclaw Guardrails
description:
HealthClaw Guardrails is the security layer between AI agents and clinical FHIR data. Every agent read passes through PHI redaction (names truncated to initials, DOBs to year, identifiers masked). Every write requires an HMAC-signed step-up token with a 5-minute TTL. Clinical writes (Condition, MedicationRequest, DiagnosticReport) return HTTP 428 until a human confirms. Every access lands in an append-only audit trail scoped by tenant.

Supports FHIR R4 US Core v9 (stable) and FHIR R6 v6.0.0-ballot3 (experimental). Proxies upstream FHIR servers (HAPI, Epic sandbox, Medplum via OAuth2 client-credentials, SMART Health IT) so the same guardrails apply whether you're on local SQLite or production EHRs.

Bundled skills: fhir-r6-guardrails (core MCP + 14 tools), curatr (patient-facing data-quality evaluation and correction), fasten-connect (patient-authorized EHR ingestion + TEFCA), phi-redaction (HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification), fhir-upstream-proxy (vendor-neutral server proxy), healthex-export (portable health record export).
longDescription:
Ships **14 skills** and **2 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (14): `check-sources` (Survey ALL connected health data sources at once), `curatr` (HealthClaw Curatr (healthclaw.io) — patient-facing FHIR data quality evaluation and correction), `fasten-connect` (Use this skill whenever connecting a patient's real health records from EHR systems (Epic, Cerner, Athena) or the…), `fhir-r6-guardrails` (HealthClaw Guardrails (healthclaw.io) — FHIR agent guardrails for clinical data access via MCP), `fhir-upstream-proxy` (Connect to real FHIR servers through the MCP guardrail proxy), `getting-started` (End-to-end onboarding for the HealthClaw + OpenClaw personal-health-agent stack), `healthbankone` (Pull verified medical records and digital-identity context from Health Bank One (https://www.healthbankone.com) via their MCP server), `healthex-export` (HealthClaw HealthEx Export (healthclaw.io) — automated personal health record export from the local HealthClaw FHIR store), and 6 more
- **MCP servers** (2): `healthclaw-local`, `healthbankone`

Installs with `claude plugin install healthclaw-guardrails@claude-community` from `aks129/HealthClawGuardrails`.
